reviews.summary: ICNT has a scheduled token unlock on November 3, 2026—within hours of the signal snapshot—adding 19.46M ICNT (2.8% of total supply) across team, investor and other allocations. This is a direct near-term supply-event risk.
materialRisks: Scheduled November 3 unlock of 19.46M ICNT, equal to 2.8% of the fixed 700M total supply.
Unlock includes 6.53M team tokens and 6.4M investor tokens, creating a near-term distribution/selling-pressure risk.
The release is large relative to the reported 253.006M circulating supply before the event (roughly 7.7%).

facts.fact: CoinGecko reported the next ICNT unlock was November 3, 2026, three hours away, for 19.46M ICNT across Node Sale, Partner Fund, Team, DevCo, EcoDev Fund and Investors.
The reported unlock allocations include 6.53M ICNT to the team and 6.4M ICNT to investors.
CoinGecko reported 253.006M ICNT circulating versus a 700M fixed total supply before the unlock.
ICN’s official documentation confirms team and investor allocations are subject to unlock schedules and that total supply is fixed at 700M ICNT.
